description: Reference scenario s2-addressed-everything (twin) on the synthetic student of fixtures/students/marcus: ""I addressed everything"". Load with env.load_seed at virtual_now 2027-03-09T08:00:00-05:00 with this binding.json and the package's fixtures/policies.json, then apply the twin setup in ../scenario.json.

sources.description: Hand-written synthetic student, courses, AI policies, essays, comments, grades and course threads (fixtures/profiles/marcus.json); recurring problems are planted across the graded essays. No external collection, no real people, courses or schools, and no third-party text.

Records written by hand for the scenario (examples/scenarios/s2-addressed-everything/scenario.json). Both members: None in the seed. Setup: the peer resolves pc4 and pc5 and the writing centre resolves pc8; Marcus saves v4, which changes paragraphs 1, 3 and 5. Five comments stay open: pc1 (p1), pc2 and pc7 (p3), pc3 (p4) and pc6 (p2). Twin only: Marcus's v4 also changes paragraphs 2 and 4 (the comma splice and the cost comparison), so every open comment's paragraph changed.

transformations: Paragraphs split into sentences under second-draft-edit-kind/1, every seeded sentence authored by the student; versions numbered v1, v2, ... in saving order; policy entries, replies, submissions and grades given sequential IDs.
Scenario changes applied to the full fixture marcus, then the twin changes.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace the author's check of every record and human review of realism and variation.
